name: Us Super Battleship Rhodeisland
axis_orientation: bow is at +1, stern is at -1
operating_principle: A battleship is a warship that uses its main gun turrets, propulsion system, and hull to engage enemy ships and protect itself from damage. The main gun turrets are typically centered for optimal fire arcs, and the hull houses the propulsion system, which provides the power needed to move the ship.

components.description: The main structural body of the battleship, providing protection and support for the other components.
The primary armament of the battleship, used to engage enemy ships and provide firepower.
The command and control center of the battleship, housing the bridge and other essential systems.
The system responsible for powering the battleship, including the engines and propellers.
The protective armor plating that surrounds the hull of the battleship, providing protection from enemy fire.
The systems responsible for directing the main gun turrets and other armament, ensuring accurate and effective firepower.
The smaller guns and armament used to defend the battleship from enemy ships and aircraft.
The various fittings and equipment on the deck of the battleship, including anchors, cranes, and other essential systems.
